title: Agent run context
description: Shared input for every stage. Written by the coordinator at kickoff from .env + discovery.

source_type.description: Federation source dialect from SOURCE_TYPE in .env.

foreign_catalog.description: UC foreign catalog mirroring the source database.

uc_catalog.description: User-chosen managed UC catalog for bronze/silver/gold/ops.

source_database.description: Source database / schema name on the federated system.

legacy_proc_schema.description: Optional hint; discovery enumerates all user proc schemas.

routines_skipped_reason.description: Set when MySQL routines were not exported (e.g. mysql CLI missing).
